summary: Frontend E2E testing of paid Parts Finder (/parts-finder) — all 7 scenarios from review request PASSED. Guest gating, authenticated access bar, one-time payment by balance and points, subscription purchase via balance, post-subscription unlimited search, and neutral client-facing note all verified end-to-end with real balance/points decrements.

test_results.pay_balance_then_results: PASS — finder-results appeared after balance payment; balance decreased 1640 → 1540 (-100, matches request_price 100 ₽)
test_results.subscribe_via_balance: PASS — finder-sub-balance-btn click → 'Подписка активна' with finder-sub-until = 'Безлимит до 26.07.2026'; balance decreased 1540 → 550 (-990 ₽)

critical_code_review_comments: PartsFinderPage.js: 'requires_payment' branch sets payPrompt but on points/balance retry uses runSearch(payWith) — works, but consider also resetting payPrompt to null on result success (currently relies on setResult+setPayPrompt(null) at top of runSearch — verified OK).

Toast was observed appearing twice in a row in test ('Списано 200 баллов', 'Списано 200 баллов') — likely due to React StrictMode double-effect in dev or duplicate sonner mount. Worth investigating to avoid double-toast UX in production.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing demo user balance/points. Test consumed: 200 баллов (pay points) + 100 ₽ (pay balance) + 990 ₽ (subscription). Resulting state: balance 550 ₽, points 365388, active subscription until 26.07.2026 (30 days).
